lore: When the storm put out the archive lighthouse, three hundred boats were already sailing in with the islands' saves. Each one was waved off and told to try again later. Keeper Wren can only berth twenty boats a tick once the lamp is lit again. If every boat comes straight back, the harbour drowns in boats circling a dark tower; if they all wait the same doubling time, they all come back together and most get waved off again. A little luck in the waiting is what gets the whole fleet home.

lines.start: Lamp's out. Every boat, turn about and try me again later. Later, mind you, not right away.
lines.dark: Still dark! Stop circling, you're only burning rope.
lines.lit: Light's back. Twenty berths a tick, no more.
lines.win: Every save berthed before the tide, and hardly a wasted lap among them.
lines.fail: Either you wore the sea out circling or you all came back at once and jammed my berths. Again.
